question: Which of the following classical music instruments is performed by Pandit Shiv Kumar Sharma?
solution:
The correct answer is Santoor.

 
• Pandit Shiv Kumar Sharma was an Indian classical musician and santoor player.
 
• The Indian santoor instrument is a trapezoid-shaped hammered dulcimer and a variation of the Iranian Santoor.
 
• The instrument is generally made of walnut and has 25 bridges.
 
• The violin is sometimes known as a fiddle.
 
• The kanjira is a South Indian frame drum. 
 
• In the ancient texts, Narada is credited with inventing the Veena.
